intent.raw: Invoke plan for the refreshed ide-extension session content workbench.
intent.objective: Author an execution-ready trusted-local V0 plan for project HTML publication, complete-revision automatic update, generic interaction polling, and real Codex value witnesses.
intent.operator_sentence: Plan the smallest route from Codex-created HTML to an interactive local workbench and back to the active session.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The refreshed design and brownfield runtime anchors converge on one sequential plan. Invoke plans locally; any later delegated SWU requires separate user authorization.
receipt_requirements: Each selected SWU returns status, files, validation, blockers, residue, reroute, and handoff note.

steps.name: Build bounded planning context
stop_conditions: Block if the refreshed design or decision gate is not pass.

steps.name: Author layered split plan
stop_conditions: Block if a task lacks implementation algorithm, exact write scope, edge cases, done criteria, or validation.
Block if security hardening or remote multi-user scope displaces the trusted-local value witnesses.

steps.name: Validate smallest units and recomposition
stop_conditions: Block if Distill blocks or any hidden acceptance gap lacks an owner.

steps.name: Execute contracts and manual display

outputs.ref: Task Session results for SWU-SCW-001 through SWU-SCW-004

steps.evidence_artifact: one Task Session result per selected SWU
stop_conditions: Stop on replay regression, path/hash ambiguity, or failed manual presentation display.

steps.name: Execute automatic update and interaction return

outputs.ref: Task Session results for SWU-SCW-005 through SWU-SCW-007

steps.evidence_artifact: automatic update and generic interaction evidence
stop_conditions: Stop on partial revision display, lost reconnect, specialized skill API, or stale interaction admission.

steps.name: Run real Codex value witnesses

outputs.ref: real presentation, Decision Gate, Craft, and closure evidence

steps.evidence_artifact: SWU-SCW-008 and SWU-SCW-009 Task Session results
stop_conditions: Block if live Codex or browser is unavailable; never simulate the real witnesses.

gates.condition: Plan, layering, work-pack, five tasks, nine SWUs, five waves, and first route are complete and navigable.
Smallest-unit, recomposition, hidden-gap, overbuild, and navigation checks pass.
Exactly one ready SWU is selected before every Task Session mutation.
Manual display precedes automatic update and generic interaction precedes domain witnesses.
V0 evidence is not promoted into security, remote, multi-user, snapshot, or effect-completion claims.

boundaries.contract: Task Session receives exactly one selected SWU with its path, dependencies, scope, done criteria, and validation, then returns a structured result.
A complete project HTML file is published by relative path and hash; notifications carry metadata only; the browser fetches the committed revision.
A generic named JSON interaction is durably stored with surface/revision/cursor and retrieved through session polling.
Automated fixtures cannot substitute for the real presentation and interaction value witnesses.

authority.execution: task-session for one selected SWU; active Codex only in real witnesses
authority.validation: Node/schema/Playwright suites, Distill, and human witness review
authority.evidence: Task Session receipts, browser assets, kernel events, CLI poll outputs, and closure reports
authority.memory: plan artifacts and bounded evidence; no copied HTML body in event logs
authority.promotion: human approval through the owning lifecycle

state_namespaces.namespace: projects/ide-extension runtime source and local state
state_namespaces.write_policy: exact SWU scope with regression evidence
complete file revisions published by reference
serialized event append and deterministic replay

promotion_splits.rule: A separate approved design and plan must justify security, authentication, snapshots, multi-user routing, or effect authority.

promotion_guardrails: No runtime implementation occurs during Invoke plan.
No Task Session begins without one selected ready SWU.
No automatic update begins before manual display evidence passes.
No specialized Decision Gate or Craft server endpoint replaces the generic event envelope.
No browser request event is described as completed Craft execution.
No live witness failure is simulated as success.
No V0 value evidence promotes V1 authority.
